products.name: Majestic Dawn Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: Majestic Dawn Three Pack Blister [Mime Jr.]
products.note: Two Majestic Dawn packs, a third pack from a late EX-series set (not simulated), a Lucario coin and the cosmos holo Mime Jr. promo (DP22). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and Collector's Cache's 'Majestic Dawn Blister Exclusive' titles.

products.name: Majestic Dawn Three Pack Blister [Glameow]
products.note: Two Majestic Dawn packs, a third pack from a late EX-series set (not simulated), a Lucario coin and the cosmos holo Glameow promo (DP23). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and Collector's Cache's 'Majestic Dawn Blister Exclusive' titles.

products.name: Majestic Dawn Two Pack Blister [Manaphy]
products.note: One Majestic Dawn pack and one POP Series 6 pack (not simulated) with a cosmos holo Manaphy from POP Series 6 (a reprint, not simulated). Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt, found twice, no second site.

products.name: Darkrai Premium Box
products.priceSource: The box has no TCGplayer listing or market price; priced at its cosmos holo Darkrai promo's TCGplayer market price (DP24, listing 84701, $57.30, tcgcsv 2026-10-01)
products.note: The real box (12 May 2008, Bulbapedia's merchandise page and Collector's Cache's 'Darkrai Premium Box Exclusive' titles) held an EX Crystal Guardians pack, an EX Dragon Frontiers pack and a Secret Wonders theme deck with the cosmos holo Darkrai promo (DP24) and a jumbo Darkrai; the pack and deck mix is medium confidence and none of it is a Majestic Dawn pack, so only the promo is opened here (the jumbo and the deck are not simulated).
